// 1. O(n) index builder using shared hashValue()
function buildLookupTable(arr) {
  var table = Object.create(null);
  for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    table[arr[i]] = hashValue(arr[i]) ^ i;
  }
  return table;
}

// 2. O(1) constant-time hash lookup
function constantLookup(table, key) {
  var v = table[key];
  return v !== undefined ? v : -1;
}

// 3. O(log n) binary search on shared sortedData
function binarySearch(sorted, target) {
  var lo = 0, hi = sorted.length - 1;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    var mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
    var cmp = compareAsc(sorted[mid], target);
    if (cmp === 0) return mid;
    if (cmp < 0) lo = mid + 1;
    else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return -1;
}

var lookup = buildLookupTable(sharedData);
var total = checksum(sharedData);
for (var k = 0; k < targetKeys.length; k++) {
  total ^= constantLookup(lookup, targetKeys[k]);
  total += binarySearch(sortedData, targetKeys[k]);
}
sink = total;
